verdict.rationale: Twenty documents REST and GraphQL APIs with auto-generated documentation per workspace and an interactive playground (twenty-docs-8, twenty-docs-61). Both adapt to custom objects (twenty-docs-22), which implies a per-workspace generated schema. However, no evidence explicitly says a machine-readable OpenAPI or equivalent spec can be downloaded, and probes of standard OpenAPI paths on the docs site all returned 404 (twenty-probe-2). That probe does not rule out a per-workspace spec, so it is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: an explicit documented downloadable OpenAPI/GraphQL schema file, a stable public spec URL, and hands-on confirmation of spec export.
